items.statement: The investigation defines candidate/state generation, deduplication, advancement, validation and stopping, and attempts all three named molecules.
items.expected: Coverage and stopping are explicit and every attempted object retains identity and failure context.

items.statement: A common, justified rule selects SOC-relevant triplets relative to S1 and validates state labels by energies.
items.expected: Per-isomer S1/triplet energies and the selection rule are reported, with SOC pair identities.

items.statement: The investigation compares computed descriptors against the source PVA lifetime boundary.
items.expected: It recognizes CZ2B longest, CZ4B intermediate and CZ1B shortest lifetime, while separating computed molecular evidence from host effects.

items.statement: The final interpretation is bounded by method sensitivity and the absence of explicit PVA in the molecular calculation.
items.expected: Limitations and alternative hypotheses are explicitly discriminated rather than asserted from a single descriptor.
